I think this can be handled more cleanly, similar to how we handle types in other functions within this provider.

Instead of checking each type inline, we can first guard on `chunk.Index != nil && chunk.ContentBlock != nil`, and then use a `switch` on `chunk.ContentBlock.Type` inside that block. Each supported type can have its own case, with a `default` that returns `nil, nil, false`. This should make the logic easier to read and extend.

Let me know what you think.
